mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, task_id, biz_id, employer_id, worker_id, initiator_id, status, last_message_at, created_at FROM chat_conversation WHERE scope = #{scope} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND employer_id = #{employerId} AND worker_id = #{workerId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversation SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'OPEN'
